oil.when: 2011 without Driver Information Center buttons (trip odometer stem)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Shift to Park and turn the ignition to ON/RUN with the engine off.
Press the trip odometer reset stem until OIL LIFE REMAINING shows.
Press and hold the stem until the display reads 100%. Three chimes sound and the CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON message goes off.
Turn the key to LOCK/OFF. If the message comes back at the next start, repeat the steps.
Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition to ON/RUN with the engine off.
Press the vehicle information button until OIL LIFE REMAINING shows.
Press and hold the set/reset button until the display reads 100%. Three chimes sound and the CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON message goes off.
Turn the key to LOCK/OFF. If the message comes back at the next start, repeat the steps.

notes: Even if the oil life system has not asked for a change, change the oil and filter at least once a year.
